longDescription.text: Gain a 100–460 damage Shield for 2.5 seconds.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.description: Removes all disables (excluding suppression and airborne) and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and gives Tenacity.

longDescription.text: Removes all crowd control debuffs (excluding Suppression and Airborne) and summoner spell debuffs from you and grants 75% Tenacity for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Exhaust
spells.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their damage dealt.

longDescription.text: Slows target enemy champion by 40% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Flash
spells.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

longDescription.text: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

spells.name: Ghost
spells.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration.

longDescription.text: Gain 24–48% Move Speed and become Ghosted for 10 seconds.
Ghost: Ignore collision with other units.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Restores Health and grants Move Speed to you and target allied champion.

longDescription.text: Restores 80–318 Health and grants 30% Move Speed for 1 second to you and target allied champion.
If cast without a target, it will cast on the most wounded allied champion in range.
Healing is halved on units recently affected by Summoner Heal.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration.

longDescription.text: Deals 70–475 true damage to target enemy champion over 5 seconds and applies 40% Grievous Wounds for the duration.
Wounds: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

spells.name: Smite
spells.description: Deals true damage to a monster or minion.

longDescription.text: Deals 600 true damage to target large monster or lane minion.
Deals 40 true damage to champion pets.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: After a brief channel, become untargetable and travel to an allied unit. Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport, which significantly increases travel speed.

longDescription.text: After channeling for 3 seconds, become Untargetable and travel to target allied structure, minion, or ward.
Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport at 10 minutes, which significantly increases travel speed.
